start.title: Two Nations in the Womb
start.text:
You are Jacob. From birth you grasped Esau's heel.
He runs the wild fields. You stay among the tents.

choices.text: Cook lentil stew at the tent
choices.feedback: Genesis 25:29 — Jacob was cooking stew when Esau came in from the field.

choices.text: Run after Esau into the open hills
choices.feedback: The thorns tear your robe. The hunt is not yours.

hunt_consequence.title: Not Your Field
hunt_consequence.text:
Esau laughs from a ridge. "Go home, brother.
The wild is mine." You walk back, empty.

choices.text: Return to the tents and cook
choices.feedback: Mother smiles. "The Lord's word is on the quiet ones."

the_stew.title: Esau Returns Famished
the_stew.text:
Esau staggers in from the field, faint with hunger.
"Quick — let me gulp some of that red stuff!"

choices.text: Ask for the birthright in exchange
choices.feedback: Genesis 25:31 — Jacob told Esau to sell him his birthright first.

choices.text: Just give him the stew freely
choices.feedback: He eats and leaves. The promise of Abraham passes you by.

choices.text: Send him away — let him hunt his own
choices.feedback: He curses and storms off. Mercy was the smaller test.

free_consequence.title: A Door Reopens
free_consequence.text:
Days later, hunger drives him back. The Lord's choosing
still waits on a word — yours.

choices.text: This time, ask for the birthright
choices.feedback: He nods, weary. "Take it. What good is it to me?"

send_consequence.title: He Comes Back
send_consequence.text:
He returns at dusk, softer, hungrier.
A second chance walks through the tent flap.

choices.text: Offer the stew for the birthright
choices.feedback: "Swear to me first." The pot steams between you.

the_oath.title: "Swear to Me First"
the_oath.text:
"Look — I'm about to die. What good is a birthright to me?"
His hand reaches for the bowl.

choices.text: Make him swear before you give it
choices.feedback: Genesis 25:33 — Jacob made Esau swear to him before he ate the bread and lentil stew.

choices.text: Trust his word — hand him the bowl
choices.feedback: He eats, laughs, walks out. Nothing was sealed but bread.

trust_consequence.title: Words Are Wind
trust_consequence.text:
Mother takes you aside. "A promise unsealed is no promise.
When he comes again — bind him with an oath."

choices.text: Wait, and bind him with an oath next time
choices.feedback: Esau returns. This time, he swears. The birthright is yours.

stew_eaten.title: Bread, Stew, and a Birthright
stew_eaten.text:
Esau eats and drinks, rises and walks away.
So he despised his birthright. The years go on.

choices.text: Keep the secret and live quietly
choices.feedback: Years pass. Isaac grows old, his eyes dim with age.

isaac_old.title: Isaac Calls for Esau
isaac_old.text:
Father is old. His eyes see only shadows. He calls Esau:
"Hunt me venison. I will bless you before I die."

choices.text: Wait quietly — go to your mother Rebekah
choices.feedback: Genesis 27:5-6 — Rebekah overheard Isaac speaking to Esau and then spoke to Jacob.

choices.text: Confront Esau — demand the blessing now
choices.feedback: He laughs. "You have my birthright. The blessing is mine."

choices.text: Walk away — the blessing is not for you
choices.feedback: Mother stops you at the door. "The Lord told me — the older shall serve the younger."

confront_consequence.title: Mother Calls You Aside
confront_consequence.text:
Rebekah pulls you into the inner tent.
"Do nothing yet. Listen — and obey my voice."

choices.text: Listen to your mother's plan
choices.feedback: You sit. Her voice is low and certain.

walkaway_consequence.title: The Word at Your Birth
walkaway_consequence.text:
"Two nations are in your womb," the Lord told her.
"The older shall serve the younger." She remembers.

choices.text: Listen to her plan
choices.feedback: You bow your head. "Tell me what to do."

rebekah_plan.title: "Obey My Voice"
rebekah_plan.text:
"Bring me two young goats. I will make a dish your father loves.
You will go to him and receive the blessing."

choices.text: "But Esau is hairy, and I am smooth…"
choices.feedback: Genesis 27:11-12 — Jacob expressed concern to Rebekah that his father would discover the deception because Esau was hairy and he was smooth.

choices.text: Refuse — the deception is too great
choices.feedback: She holds your face. "The Lord has spoken. Do not turn back now."

refuse_blessing.title: The Word Stands
refuse_blessing.text:
"The promise is on you. The Lord said it before you were born.
Obey my voice, my son. Only obey."

choices.text: Accept — let her dress you
choices.feedback: The kid-skins are warm against your arms. Your heart pounds.

the_disguise.title: Esau's Garments
the_disguise.text:
She brings Esau's best robes — they smell of the open field.
The kid-skins cover your hands and the smooth of your neck.

choices.text: Take the dish and go to your father
choices.feedback: The savory smell rises around you. You step toward the inner tent.

father_tent.title: "Who Are You, My Son?"
father_tent.text:
Isaac lifts his blind face. "Who is it?"
Your throat is dry. The moment hangs.

choices.text: "I am Esau your firstborn."
choices.feedback: Genesis 27:19 — Jacob told his father Isaac, "I am Esau your firstborn."

choices.text: "It is I, Jacob — forgive me."
choices.feedback: He recoils. "Then leave me — go!" The blessing slips away.

choices.text: Stay silent and offer the dish
choices.feedback: "Speak, my son. Who are you?" There is no path forward without words.

confess_consequence.title: Mother at the Door
confess_consequence.text:
Rebekah pulls you back. "The hour is now. Esau returns soon.
Go back. Speak the words I gave you."

choices.text: Return and say, "I am Esau your firstborn."
choices.feedback: You step back into the tent. Your father turns his head.

silent_consequence.title: He Asks Again
silent_consequence.text:
"My son — speak. Who is it?"
The silence cannot hold.

choices.text: Answer, "I am Esau your firstborn."
choices.feedback: The words come. "I have done as you asked. Sit and eat."

the_test.title: "Come Near That I May Feel You"
the_test.text:
Isaac reaches out trembling hands.
"The voice is Jacob's, but the hands are Esau's."

choices.text: Hold still and let him feel the kid-skins
choices.feedback: Genesis 27:22-23 — Isaac felt Jacob, who was wearing the skins of the young goats, and believed he was Esau.

choices.text: Pull back — flee the tent
choices.feedback: Rebekah catches you outside. "Go back. The Lord's hand is on this hour."

flee_consequence.title: No Time Left
flee_consequence.text:
Esau is already on the hills. The window closes.
"Go back, my son. Now."

choices.text: Return and stand still
choices.feedback: You enter again. He reaches out. You let him feel.

the_blessing.title: The Words of Blessing
the_blessing.text:
"May God give you the dew of heaven and the fatness of the earth.
Let peoples serve you. Cursed be those who curse you."

choices.text: Receive the blessing and slip away
choices.feedback: You bow. You leave. The tent flap falls behind you like a closing door.

esau_returns.title: Esau Returns from the Hunt
esau_returns.text:
From outside the tent you hear his voice — then a great cry.
"Bless me, even me also, O my father!"

choices.text: Listen, hidden behind the tent
choices.feedback: Isaac trembles. "Your brother came in deceit and took your blessing."

esau_wrath.title: "I Will Kill My Brother"
esau_wrath.text:
Esau's voice rises like fire. "The days of mourning my father
are near. Then I will slay Jacob."

choices.text: Run to your mother
choices.feedback: Genesis 27:43 — Rebekah told Jacob to flee to her brother Laban in Haran.

choices.text: Confront Esau — beg his forgiveness
choices.feedback: His knife is half-drawn. Mother pulls you back through the tent flap.

confront_esau_consequence.title: Not Yet — Not Now
confront_esau_consequence.text:
Rebekah holds your face. "He will not hear you tonight.
Go to Haran. To my brother. Until his fury turns away."

choices.text: Go to your mother's plan
choices.feedback: You bow. The night is wide. The road to Haran is far.

rebekah_warning.title: "Flee to Haran"
rebekah_warning.text:
"Stay with Laban a few days, until your brother's anger turns.
I will send for you. Why should I lose you both in one day?"

choices.text: Pack lightly and slip out at dusk
choices.feedback: Genesis 27:43 — Rebekah told Jacob to flee to Haran, to her brother Laban, and stay with him for a while.

choices.text: Refuse — you will not run
choices.feedback: "Then you will die," she whispers. "And the promise dies with you."

refuse_flee_consequence.title: The Promise Must Live
refuse_flee_consequence.text:
Her grip is iron. "The Lord chose you before your birth.
Flee tonight. Live. Return when it is time."

choices.text: Yield and prepare to leave
choices.feedback: You gather a staff and a cloak. Nothing more.

isaac_sends.title: A Father's Last Word
isaac_sends.text:
Isaac calls you in. He lays his hand on your head once more.
"Take a wife from Laban's daughters. May God Almighty bless you."

choices.text: Bow, and set out alone toward Haran
choices.feedback: The blessing is sealed. You step into the dusk with a staff in your hand.

the_road.title: The Long Road East
the_road.text:
Behind you — the tents of your father.
Ahead — Haran, and a stone for a pillow under a wide sky.
